node.title: Re: using Path::Tiny and reformating result
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm not sure why I'm being warned about wide characters. If I use utf8; and $path1->lines_utf8;, am I not projecting my intent?

Not fully: The [doc://utf8] pragma tells Perl that your source file is encoded in UTF-8 (nothing else), and ->lines_utf8 reads the file as a UTF-8 encoded file. The thing missing here is the output: your STDOUT is not set up to output Unicode. Try adding the [http://perldoc.perl.org/open.html|open] pragma: use open qw/:std :utf8/;

As for your formatting questions, I'm not entirely sure I understand - is your output fixed-width, like in a terminal or 

 tags, or is it HTML?
